19477.overview:
Update 1.2 - INFECTION! New level, new mode, new weapons and new enemies!

Feeling angry?

RED is the ultimate dual stick shooter - visceral, vibrant and filled to the brim with unlockables!

Take the role of Rick Steele as he battles an invasion of mutants in the city. Using a variety of powerups, abilities and weapons, he will need to fend off hordes of disgusting and furious creatures dead set on consuming everything and everyone in their sight.

Featuring:

- Smexy cartoon graphics
- Same couch multiplayer *NEW*
- Unique player abilities
- Special bonuses like the powerful Bio-Shield
- Competitive leaderboards
- Infection infinite survival mode

PLUS! - Buy the full version for even more future content!

1.11 - NEW IN GAME BESTIARY + BALANCE IMPROVEMENTS!

19532.overview:
Ravensword brings unprecedented visuals to the role playing and adventure
genre. Explore a vast and richly detailed world, gather powerful weapons, collect hundreds of items, increase your skills, and follow a deep storyline to solve the mysteries of the Kingdom of Tyreas.

19769.overview:
Regular Ordinary Boy is a retro action-adventure sidescroller.

* Hit stuff with swords
* Kill monsters, collect gold and other loot
* Purchase new swords and armor at shops on your journey
* Defeat epic bosses
* Find hidden treasures

Can you defeat the evil wizard who burned your house down?

* 10 unique monsters, each with 5 levels of difficulty
* 4 bosses to defeat
* 7 unique levels to explore
* Action based side scrolling gameplay, kill all those monsters!

Retro Style

* Retro graphics
* Old school sound effects
* Retro sounding chiptune music

"Pretty goooood"

"Reminds me of my old school consoles!"

"I played it, and I liked it!"

19787.overview: Adventure through this exciting platformer as Rhodri. You can't jump, but springs, fans, and other mechanics will help you traverse these challenging levels.
